talk: wikinews:Dark matter lacks extra gravitational force
title: Dark matter lacks extra gravitational force

zh: 该团队正在寻找的效应可能是由星系暗物质和银河系暗物质之间的潮汐力引起的。

talk: wikinews:Dark matter lacks extra gravitational force
title: Dark matter lacks extra gravitational force

zh: 科学家们可以得出结论，暗物质对其他暗物质的影响方式与普通物质相同。

talk: wikinews:Dark matter lacks extra gravitational force
title: Dark matter lacks extra gravitational force
en: This theory says that most dark matter around a galaxy is located around a galaxy in a kind of halo, and is made of lots of small particles.
zh: 该理论认为，一个星系周围的大多数暗物质都处在星系周围的某种光环中，由许多小粒子组成。

talk: wikinews:Explosion at earthquake-damaged Fukushima nuclear power plant
title: Explosion at earthquake-damaged Fukushima nuclear power plant

talk: wikinews:Extremely drug-resistant tuberculosis strain emerges in South Africa

talk: wikinews:Extremely drug-resistant tuberculosis strain emerges in South Africa
title: Extremely drug-resistant tuberculosis strain emerges in South Africa

zh: 他在一次采访中表示，这个新变种“非常令人不安和担忧，因为它的致死率非常高。”

talk: wikinews:Extremely drug-resistant tuberculosis strain emerges in South Africa
title: Extremely drug-resistant tuberculosis strain emerges in South Africa
en: Some patients might have contracted the bug in the hospital, Dr. Moll thinks, and at least two were hospital health workers.
zh: 莫尔 (Moll) 博士认为，有些病人可能是在医院感染了病菌，而且至少有两名病人是医院的医护人员。

talk: wikinews:Extremely drug-resistant tuberculosis strain emerges in South Africa
title: Extremely drug-resistant tuberculosis strain emerges in South Africa
en: In one year's time, an infected person may infect 10 to 15 close contacts.
zh: 一年内，一个感染者可能会感染 10 至 15 名密切接触者。

talk: wikinews:Extremely drug-resistant tuberculosis strain emerges in South Africa
title: Extremely drug-resistant tuberculosis strain emerges in South Africa
en: However, the percentage of XDR-TB in the entire group of people with tuberculosis still seems to be low; 6,000 of the total 330,000 people infected at any particular moment in South Africa.
zh: 然而，广泛耐药结核病在整个结核病患者群体中所占的比例似乎仍然很低；在南非，在任意特定时刻，总计 33 万人中只有 6000 人感染。

talk: wikinews:Burning debris from satellites spotted over several US cities
title: Burning debris from satellites spotted over several US cities

talk: wikinews:Burning debris from satellites spotted over several US cities

talk: wikinews:Burning debris from satellites spotted over several US cities
title: Burning debris from satellites spotted over several US cities

zh: 他们仍在努力确定这次撞击的规模以及对地球的影响。

talk: wikinews:Burning debris from satellites spotted over several US cities
title: Burning debris from satellites spotted over several US cities

title: Doctor to be charged after mother's death in Ohio

zh: 29 岁的 Malar Balasubramanian 医生在俄亥俄州辛辛那提市以北约 15 英里的郊区布鲁艾施被发现，她被找到时身穿 T 恤衫和内裤，躺在路边的地上，看上去服用了大量药物。

talk: wikinews:Doctor to be charged after mother's death in Ohio
title: Doctor to be charged after mother's death in Ohio

talk: wikinews:Doctor to be charged after mother's death in Ohio
title: Doctor to be charged after mother's death in Ohio

talk: wikinews:Doctor to be charged after mother's death in Ohio
title: Doctor to be charged after mother's death in Ohio

title: India struggles with encephalitis outbreak
en: The first cases of the disease this season were reported in late July.
zh: 7 月下旬报告了本季节的第一批病例。

title: India struggles with encephalitis outbreak
en: The disease is carried by pigs, which then migrates to humans through mosquitos.
zh: 猪携带该疾病，然后通过蚊子传染给人类。

title: India struggles with encephalitis outbreak
en: The outbreak has prompted the Indian government to undertake such measures as deployment of pig catchers in seriously affected areas, distributing thousands of mosquito curtains and spraying pesticides.
zh: 这场疫情促使印度政府采取一些措施，比如在严重感染地区放置捕猪器、派发数千个蚊帐并喷洒杀虫剂。

title: India struggles with encephalitis outbreak
en: Several million vials of encephalitis vaccine have also been promised by the government, which will help prepare health agencies for next year.
zh: 政府还承诺提供数百万剂脑炎疫苗，这将有助于医疗机构为明年做好准备。

title: India struggles with encephalitis outbreak
en: Plans for vaccines to be delivered to the historically most affected areas this year were delayed due to lack of funds and low prioritisation relative to other diseases.
zh: 由于缺乏资金，且与其他疾病相比优先级较低，今年向历史上疫情最严重的地区提供疫苗的计划被推迟了。

talk: wikinews:Noted stamp engraver Czeslaw Slania dies at 83
title: Noted stamp engraver Czeslaw Slania dies at 83

zh: 1956 年，斯拉尼亚（Słania）搬到了瑞典。三年后他开始在瑞典邮局上班，成为首席邮票雕刻师。

talk: wikinews:Noted stamp engraver Czeslaw Slania dies at 83
title: Noted stamp engraver Czeslaw Slania dies at 83
en: He produced over 1,000 stamps for Sweden and 28 other countries.
zh: 他曾为瑞典和其他 28 个国家/地区制作过 1000 多版邮票。

talk: wikinews:Noted stamp engraver Czeslaw Slania dies at 83
title: Noted stamp engraver Czeslaw Slania dies at 83
en: His work is of such recognized quality and detail that he is one of the very few "household names" among philatelists. Some specialize in collecting his work alone.
zh: 他的作品极具辨识度，拥有高质量和丰富的细节，这也使得他成为了极少数在集邮人士中“家喻户晓”的人物之一。有些人专门收集他的作品。

talk: wikinews:Noted stamp engraver Czeslaw Slania dies at 83
title: Noted stamp engraver Czeslaw Slania dies at 83
en: His 1,000th stamp was the magnificent "Great Deeds by Swedish Kings" by David Klöcker Ehrenstrahl in 2000, which is listed in the Guinness Book of World Records.
zh: “他在 2000 年制作的第 1000 张邮票取材自大卫·克洛克·埃伦斯特拉尔的名画《瑞典国王的伟大功绩》，并因此入选《吉尼斯世界纪录大全》。”

talk: wikinews:Noted stamp engraver Czeslaw Slania dies at 83
title: Noted stamp engraver Czeslaw Slania dies at 83
en: He was also engaged in engraving banknotes for many countries, recent examples of his work including the Prime Ministerial portraits on the front of the new Canadian $5 and $100 bills.
zh: 他还参与了许多国家的纸币雕版制作，近期作品包括加拿大新版 5 元和 100 元纸币正面的总理肖像。

title: Crossing guard killed by truck in Glasgow, Scotland

talk: wikinews:Crossing guard killed by truck in Glasgow, Scotland

talk: wikinews:Sandra Fluke insists she will not be silenced

talk: wikinews:US officials flood Grand Canyon to restore ecosystem

talk: wikinews:Strong 6.3 earthquake reported in Sumatra, Indonesia
title: Strong 6.3 earthquake reported in Sumatra, Indonesia

title: Car women's rugby 7's tournament
en: The games kicked off at 10:00am with great weather and apart from mid morning drizzle which quickly cleared up, it was a perfect day for 7's rugby.
zh: 比赛于上午 10 点开始。天气很好，上午有毛毛雨，很快就放晴了。这样的天气对七人制橄榄球来说十分完美。

title: Car women's rugby 7's tournament
en: Tournament top seeds South Africa started on the right note when they had a comfortable 26 - 00 win against 5th seeded Zambia.
zh: 锦标赛头号种子南非队开局不错，他们以 26 - 00 轻松战胜了 5 号种子赞比亚队。

title: Car women's rugby 7's tournament
en: Looking decidedly rusty in the game against their southern sisters, South Africa however steadily improved as the tournament progressed.
zh: 在与南方姐妹队的比赛中，南非队看起来明显有点生疏，但随着比赛的进行，南非队的表现稳步改进。

title: Car women's rugby 7's tournament
en: Their disciplined defence, ball handling skills and excellent team work made them stand out and it was clear that this was the team to beat.
zh: 他们因其严格防守、控球技术和出色的团队合作脱颖而出。很显然，这是一支无往不胜的球队。

talk: wikinews:Anne Frank tree saved from being chopped down
title: Anne Frank tree saved from being chopped down
en: Officials for the city of Amsterdam and the Anne Frank Museum state that the tree is infected with a fungus and poses a public health hazard as they argue that it was in imminent danger of falling over.
zh: 阿姆斯特丹市政府和安妮·弗兰克博物馆 (Anne Frank Museum) 的官员表示，这棵树感染了一种真菌，并会对公众健康造成威胁，因为据称它随时都有倒下的危险。

talk: wikinews:Anne Frank tree saved from being chopped down
title: Anne Frank tree saved from being chopped down
en: It had been scheduled to be cut down on Tuesday, but was saved after an emergency court ruling.
zh: 按照原计划，它将在周二被砍倒，但在法庭紧急裁决后幸免遇难。

talk: wikinews:Seven caves found on Mars: NASA
title: Seven caves found on Mars: NASA
en: All of the cave entrances, which were named "The Seven Sisters", are at least 100 to 250 meters (328 to 820 feet) in diameter.
zh: 所有的洞穴入口（这些洞被称为”七姊妹“）直径至少为 100 至 250 米（328 至 820 英尺）。

talk: wikinews:Seven caves found on Mars: NASA
title: Seven caves found on Mars: NASA
en: Infrared images show that the temperature variations from night and day show that they are likely caves.
zh: 红外图像显示，昼夜温度的变化表示这些地方很可能是洞穴。

talk: wikinews:Seven caves found on Mars: NASA
title: Seven caves found on Mars: NASA
en: "They are cooler than the surrounding surface in the day and warmer at night.
zh: “比周围的表面相比，它们白天更凉，晚上更暖。

talk: wikinews:Seven caves found on Mars: NASA
title: Seven caves found on Mars: NASA
en: Their thermal behavior is not as steady as large caves on Earth that often maintain a fairly constant temperature, but it is consistent with these being deep holes in the ground," said Glen Cushing of the United States Geological Survey (USGS) Astrogeology Team and of Northern Arizona University located in Flagstaff, Arizona.
zh: “它们的热行为不像地球上的大型洞穴那么稳定，这些大型洞穴通常会保持相当恒定的温度，但它们与地下深穴的情况很相似，”亚利桑那州旗杆镇美国地质调查局 (USGS) 太空地质团队和北亚利桑那大学的格伦·库欣说道。

talk: wikinews:Akayev flees Kyrgyzstan as protesters seize control of Bishkek
title: Akayev flees Kyrgyzstan as protesters seize control of Bishkek
en: Widespread looting reportedly continued overnight, as law enforcement officers were not present on Bishkek's streets.
zh: 据报道，由于执法人员不在场，比什凯克街道上的大规模抢劫持续了一夜。

talk: wikinews:Akayev flees Kyrgyzstan as protesters seize control of Bishkek
title: Akayev flees Kyrgyzstan as protesters seize control of Bishkek
en: Bishkek was described as sinking into a state of "anarchy" by one observer, as gangs of people roamed the streets and plundered stores of consumer goods.
zh: 一名观察者形容比什凯克（Bishkek）正在陷入“无政府“ 状态，成群的人们在街上游荡，掠夺商店里的消费品。

talk: wikinews:Akayev flees Kyrgyzstan as protesters seize control of Bishkek
title: Akayev flees Kyrgyzstan as protesters seize control of Bishkek
en: Several Bishkek residents blamed protesters from the south for the lawlessness.
zh: 几个比什凯克居民将这种违法状态归咎于来自南方的抗议者。

talk: wikinews:South Africa end All Blacks' 15-game winning streak
title: South Africa end All Blacks' 15-game winning streak
en: South Africa have defeated the All Blacks (New Zealand) in a rugby union Tri Nations match at the Royal Bafokeng Stadium in Rustenburg, South Africa.
zh: 在南非勒斯滕堡（Rustenburg）皇家巴福肯体育场举行的英式橄榄球联盟三国赛中，南非队击败了全黑队（新西兰）。

talk: wikinews:South Africa end All Blacks' 15-game winning streak
title: South Africa end All Blacks' 15-game winning streak
en: The final score was a one-point victory, 21 to 20, ending the All Blacks' 15 game winning streak.
zh: 最后结果是一分险胜，比分为 21 比 20，结束了全黑队连胜 15 场的局面。

talk: wikinews:South Africa end All Blacks' 15-game winning streak
title: South Africa end All Blacks' 15-game winning streak
en: For the Springboks, it ended a five-match losing streak.
zh: 跳羚队以五连败收官。

talk: wikinews:South Africa end All Blacks' 15-game winning streak
title: South Africa end All Blacks' 15-game winning streak
en: It was the final match for the All Blacks, who had already won the trophy two weeks ago.
zh: 全黑队在两周前已经赢得了奖杯，而这场比赛是他们打的最后一场。

talk: wikinews:South Africa end All Blacks' 15-game winning streak
title: South Africa end All Blacks' 15-game winning streak
en: The final match of the series will take place at Ellis Park in Johannesburg next week, when the Springboks play Australia.
zh: 该系列赛的最后一场比赛将于下周在约翰内斯堡 (Johannesburg) 的埃利斯公园举行，届时斯普林博克斯 (Springboks) 将迎战澳大利亚队。

talk: wikinews:Controversial Berlin opera features interactive drug usage
title: Controversial Berlin opera features interactive drug usage
en: The story presented in the French opera, by Camille Saint-Saens, is of an artist "whose life is dictated by a love for drugs and Japan."
zh: 卡米尔·圣桑 (Camille Saint-Saens) 创作的法国歌剧讲述的是一名艺术家的故事，“他一生沉迷于毒品和对日本的热爱”。

talk: wikinews:Controversial Berlin opera features interactive drug usage
title: Controversial Berlin opera features interactive drug usage
en: As a result, the performers smoke cannabis joints on stage, and the theatre itself is encouraging the audience to join in.
zh: 结果，演员在舞台上吸食大麻，剧院本身也鼓励观众一起加入。

talk: wikinews:Mitt Romney wins Iowa Caucus by eight votes over surging Rick Santorum
title: Mitt Romney wins Iowa Caucus by eight votes over surging Rick Santorum
en: Former House Speaker Newt Gingrich, Texas governor Rick Perry, and Congresswoman Michele Bachmann finished in fourth, fifth, and sixth place, respectively.
zh: 前众议院议长纽特·金里奇、德克萨斯州州长里克·佩里和女国会议员米歇尔·巴赫曼最终分别名列第四、第五和第六。

talk: wikinews:Mitt Romney wins Iowa Caucus by eight votes over surging Rick Santorum
title: Mitt Romney wins Iowa Caucus by eight votes over surging Rick Santorum
en: After the results came in, Gingrich lauded Santorum, but had tough words for Romney, on whose behalf negative campaign advertisements were aired in Iowa against Gingrich.
zh: 结果出来后，金里奇连连称赞桑托勒姆，但对罗姆尼做出严厉批评。以后者的名义，在爱荷华州放送对金里奇不利的竞选广告。

talk: wikinews:Mitt Romney wins Iowa Caucus by eight votes over surging Rick Santorum
title: Mitt Romney wins Iowa Caucus by eight votes over surging Rick Santorum
en: Perry stated that he would "return to Texas to assess the results of tonight's caucus, determine whether there is a path forward for myself in this race", but later said that he would remain in the race and compete in the January 21 South Carolina primary.
zh: 佩里表示，他会“返回得克萨斯，评估今晚党团会议的结果，明确自己在这次较量中是否有胜算的余地”。但后来他又表示会继续参加竞选，并参加于 1 月 21 日在南卡罗莱纳州举行的初选。

talk: wikinews:Mitt Romney wins Iowa Caucus by eight votes over surging Rick Santorum
title: Mitt Romney wins Iowa Caucus by eight votes over surging Rick Santorum
en: Bachmann, who won the Ames Straw Poll in August, decided to end her campaign.
zh: 八月曾在埃姆斯模拟民意调查中胜出的巴赫曼决定退出竞选。

talk: wikinews:Photojournalist photographing Justin Bieber's car run over by another vehicle
title: Photojournalist photographing Justin Bieber's car run over by another vehicle
en: The photographer was transported to Ronald Reagan UCLA Medical Center, where he subsequently died.
zh: 这名摄影师被送往加州大学洛杉矶分校罗纳德·里根医疗中心，其后不治。

talk: wikinews:Photojournalist photographing Justin Bieber's car run over by another vehicle
title: Photojournalist photographing Justin Bieber's car run over by another vehicle
en: He was reportedly aged in his 20s. In a statement, Bieber said "[w]hile I was not present nor directly involved with this tragic accident, my thoughts and prayers are with the family of the victim."
zh: 报道称他年仅 20 多岁。比伯发表声明表示：“虽然我当时并不在场，也没有直接经历这起悲惨事故，但我仍为死者家属感到悲伤，为他们祈祷。”

talk: wikinews:Photojournalist photographing Justin Bieber's car run over by another vehicle
title: Photojournalist photographing Justin Bieber's car run over by another vehicle
en: Entertainment news website TMZ understands the photographer stopped his vehicle on the other side of Sepulveda Boulevard and attempted to take pictures of the police stop before crossing the road and continuing, prompting the California Highway Patrol police officer conducting the traffic stop to order him back across, twice.
zh: 娱乐新闻网站TMZ了解到，该名摄影师在Sepulveda大道的另一侧停车，开始拍摄警察的拦截，并在横穿马路后继续拍照，促使进行交通拦截的加州公路巡警两次停下手中工作，命令他回到对面。

talk: wikinews:Photojournalist photographing Justin Bieber's car run over by another vehicle
title: Photojournalist photographing Justin Bieber's car run over by another vehicle
en: According to police, the driver of the vehicle that hit the photographer is unlikely to face criminal charges.
zh: 据警方称，撞倒摄影师的汽车司机未必会面临刑事指控。

talk: wikinews:Austria leads medal count after second day of 2013 IPC Alpine World Championships
title: Austria leads medal count after second day of 2013 IPC Alpine World Championships
en: With only eighteen medals available a day, a number of countries have failed to make the medal podium.
zh: 由于一天只颁发十八块奖牌，许多国家的运动员未能登上领奖台。

talk: wikinews:Austria leads medal count after second day of 2013 IPC Alpine World Championships
title: Austria leads medal count after second day of 2013 IPC Alpine World Championships
en: They include the Netherlands, with Anna Jochemsen finishing ninth in the women's standing class in the Super-G yesterday, and Finland with Katja Saarinen finishing tenth in the same event.
zh: 与奖牌无缘的运动员包括荷兰的安娜·乔彻姆森，她在昨天的女子站姿超级大回转比赛中获得第九名，芬兰的卡特娅·萨里宁则在同一比赛中获得第十名。

talk: wikinews:Austria leads medal count after second day of 2013 IPC Alpine World Championships
title: Austria leads medal count after second day of 2013 IPC Alpine World Championships
en: Australia's Mitchell Gourley finished eleventh in the men's standing Super-G. Czech competitor Oldrich Jelinek finished sixteenth in the men's sitting Super-G.
zh: 澳大利亚选手米切尔·古尔力获得男子站姿超级大回转比赛第十一名。捷克选手奥德里奇·耶利内克获得男子坐姿超级大回转比赛第十六名。

talk: wikinews:Austria leads medal count after second day of 2013 IPC Alpine World Championships
title: Austria leads medal count after second day of 2013 IPC Alpine World Championships
en: Arly Velasquez of Mexico finished fifteenth in the men's sitting Super-G. New Zealand's Adam Hall finished ninth in the men's standing Super-G.
zh: 墨西哥选手拉利·委拉斯开兹在男子坐姿超级大回转比赛中获得第 15 名的成绩。新西兰选手亚当·霍尔在男子站姿超级大回转比赛中获得第 9 名的成绩。

talk: wikinews:Austria leads medal count after second day of 2013 IPC Alpine World Championships
title: Austria leads medal count after second day of 2013 IPC Alpine World Championships
en: Poland's men's visually impaired skier Maciej Krezel and guide Anna Ogarzynska finished thirteenth in the Super-G. South Korea's Jong Seork Park finished twenty-fourth in the men's sitting Super-G.
zh: 波兰男子视障滑雪选手马切吉·克雷泽尔（Maciej Krezel ）和向导安娜·奥加津斯卡（Anna Ogarzynska）在超级大回转比赛中获得第十三名，韩国选手朴钟硕（Jong Seork Park）在男子坐式超级大回转比赛中获得第二十四名。

talk: wikinews:Haitian cholera victims threaten United Nations with lawsuit
title: Haitian cholera victims threaten United Nations with lawsuit
en: UN peacekeepers, whom arrived in Haiti after the 2010 earthquake, are being blamed for the spread of the disease which started near the troop's encampment.
zh: 联合国维和人员在 2010 年地震后抵达海地，他们因疫情蔓延而受到指责。疫情是从部队营地附近开始扩散的。

talk: wikinews:Haitian cholera victims threaten United Nations with lawsuit
title: Haitian cholera victims threaten United Nations with lawsuit
en: According to the lawsuit, waste from the UN camp was not properly sanitized, causing bacteria to enter the tributary of the Artibonite River, one of Haiti's largest.
zh: 诉讼材料显示，联合国营地未能对废弃物进行适当的消毒处理，因而导致细菌进入阿蒂博尼特河的支流，这是海地最大河流之一。

talk: wikinews:Haitian cholera victims threaten United Nations with lawsuit
title: Haitian cholera victims threaten United Nations with lawsuit
en: Prior to the arrival of troops, Haiti had not encountered problems related to the disease since the 1800s.
zh: 在军队到来之前，海地自 19 世纪初以来从未遇到过与该疾病有关的问题。

talk: wikinews:Haitian cholera victims threaten United Nations with lawsuit
title: Haitian cholera victims threaten United Nations with lawsuit
en: The Haitian Institute for Justice and Democracy has referenced independent studies that suggest the Nepalese UN peacekeeping battalion unknowingly brought the disease to Haiti.
zh: 海地正义与民主研究所 (Haitian Institute for Justice and Democracy) 引用的独立研究表明，是尼泊尔的联合国维和部队在不知情的情况下将这种疾病带到了海地。

talk: wikinews:Haitian cholera victims threaten United Nations with lawsuit
title: Haitian cholera victims threaten United Nations with lawsuit
en: Danielle Lantagne, a UN expert on the disease, stated the outbreak was likely caused by the peacekeepers.
zh: 研究该疾病的联合国专家丹妮尔·拉塔涅 (Danielle Lantagne) 表示，疫情爆发很可能是由维和人员引起的。

talk: wikinews:Patient under evaluation with Ebola-like symptoms in Washington D.C.
title: Patient under evaluation with Ebola-like symptoms in Washington D.C.
en: Hamilton confirmed Howard University Hospital admitted the patient in stable condition.
zh: 汉密尔顿（Hamilton）确认，霍华德大学医院收治的病人情况稳定。

talk: wikinews:Patient under evaluation with Ebola-like symptoms in Washington D.C.
title: Patient under evaluation with Ebola-like symptoms in Washington D.C.
en: The patient had been to Nigeria, where some cases of the Ebola virus have occurred.
zh: 这名患者曾去过尼日利亚，当地曾出现数宗埃博拉病毒的病例。

talk: wikinews:Patient under evaluation with Ebola-like symptoms in Washington D.C.
title: Patient under evaluation with Ebola-like symptoms in Washington D.C.
en: The hospital has followed protocol for infection control, including separating the patient from others to prevent possible infection of others.
zh: 医院遵循了感染控制规定，包括把患者与他人隔离，以防感染到其他人。

talk: wikinews:Iranian passenger jet's wheel catches fire
title: Iranian passenger jet's wheel catches fire
en: Air accidents are common in Iran, which has an aging fleet that is poorly maintained both for civil and military operations.
zh: 空难在伊朗是司空见惯的事，这个国家的民用和军用飞机都已经老化，缺少维护。

talk: wikinews:Iranian passenger jet's wheel catches fire
title: Iranian passenger jet's wheel catches fire
en: International sanctions have meant that new aircraft cannot be purchased.
zh: 在国际制裁下，伊朗无法购买新的飞机。

talk: wikinews:Iranian passenger jet's wheel catches fire
title: Iranian passenger jet's wheel catches fire
en: Earlier this week, a police helicopter crash killed three people and wounded three more.
zh: 本周早些时候，一架警用直升机坠毁，事件造成 3 人死亡，3 人受伤。

talk: wikinews:Iranian passenger jet's wheel catches fire
title: Iranian passenger jet's wheel catches fire
en: Last month Iran saw its worst air disaster in years when an airliner heading to Armenia crashed, killing the 168 on board.
zh: 上个月，伊朗一架飞往亚美尼亚的客机坠毁，机上 168 人遇难，这是伊朗多年来最惨烈的一起空难。

talk: wikinews:Iranian passenger jet's wheel catches fire
title: Iranian passenger jet's wheel catches fire
en: The same month saw another airliner overrun a runway at Mashhad and strike a wall, killing seventeen.
zh: 同一个月，又有一架客机冲出马什哈德的跑道，撞上一堵墙，造成 17 人死亡。

talk: wikinews:Aerosmith cancel remaining tour dates after on stage accident
title: Aerosmith cancel remaining tour dates after on stage accident
en: Aerosmith have cancelled their remaining concerts on their tour.
zh: 空中铁匠乐队已经取消了他们巡回演唱会的剩余场次。

talk: wikinews:Aerosmith cancel remaining tour dates after on stage accident
title: Aerosmith cancel remaining tour dates after on stage accident
en: The rock band was due to tour the United States and Canada until September 16.
zh: 这支摇滚乐队原定在美国和加拿大巡演，一直持续到 9 月 16 日。

talk: wikinews:Aerosmith cancel remaining tour dates after on stage accident
title: Aerosmith cancel remaining tour dates after on stage accident
en: They have cancelled the tour after lead singer Steven Tyler was injured after he fell off stage while performing on August 5.
zh: 主唱史蒂芬·泰勒在 8 月 5 日的演出中从舞台跌落受伤，随后乐队取消了这次巡演。

talk: wikinews:Tennis: Andy Murray wins Montreal Masters 2009
title: Tennis: Andy Murray wins Montreal Masters 2009
en: Murray lost the first set in a tie break after both men held each and every serve in the set.
zh: 双方都保住了各自的每个发球局，之后穆雷在抢七局中输掉了第一盘。

talk: wikinews:Tennis: Andy Murray wins Montreal Masters 2009
title: Tennis: Andy Murray wins Montreal Masters 2009
en: Del Potro had the early advantage in the second set, but this too required a tie break after reaching 6-6.
zh: 德尔·波特罗（Del Potro）在第二盘刚开局时就占上风，但在比分达到 6-6 后就得进行抢七大战。

talk: wikinews:Tennis: Andy Murray wins Montreal Masters 2009
title: Tennis: Andy Murray wins Montreal Masters 2009
en: Potro received treatment to his shoulder at this point but managed to return to the game.
zh: 此时波特罗接受了肩膀治疗，但仍坚持继续比赛。

talk: wikinews:2009 Shri Shyam Bhajan Hindu religious festival held in Hyderabad
title: 2009 Shri Shyam Bhajan Hindu religious festival held in Hyderabad
en: The program started at 8:30 p.m. local time (15.00 UTC).
zh: 节目于当地时间晚上 8:30 (15.00 UTC) 开始。

talk: wikinews:2009 Shri Shyam Bhajan Hindu religious festival held in Hyderabad
title: 2009 Shri Shyam Bhajan Hindu religious festival held in Hyderabad
en: Famous singers across the country presented bhajans, or devotional songs, to Shri Shyam's feet.
zh: 全国各地的著名歌手都唱祈祷歌献给 Shri Shyam。

talk: wikinews:2009 Shri Shyam Bhajan Hindu religious festival held in Hyderabad
title: 2009 Shri Shyam Bhajan Hindu religious festival held in Hyderabad
en: Singer Sanju Sharma started the evening, followed by Jai Shankar Choudhary. esented the chhappan bhog bhajan as well. Singer, Raju Khandelwal was accompanying him.
zh: 当晚由歌手桑朱·沙玛（Sanju Sharma）开场演出，随后是贾伊·尚卡尔·乔杜里 （Jai Shankar Choudhary）出场。也演唱了 chhappan bhog 祈祷歌。歌手拉朱·坎戴尔瓦尔（Raju Khandelwal） 同他一起进行了表演。

talk: wikinews:2009 Shri Shyam Bhajan Hindu religious festival held in Hyderabad
title: 2009 Shri Shyam Bhajan Hindu religious festival held in Hyderabad
en: Then, Lakkha Singh took the lead in singing the bhajans.
zh: 然后，拉卡·辛格带头唱了拜赞歌。

talk: wikinews:2009 Shri Shyam Bhajan Hindu religious festival held in Hyderabad
title: 2009 Shri Shyam Bhajan Hindu religious festival held in Hyderabad
en: 108 plates of Chhappan Bhog (in Hinduism, 56 different edible items, like, sweets, fruits, nuts, dishes etc. which are offered to deity) were served to Baba Shyam.
zh: 108 碟珍馐奉纳（Chhappan Bhog）（在印度教中，Chhappan Bhog 指供奉神灵的56 种不同食物，其中包括糖果、水果、坚果、菜品等物）供奉给 Baba Shyam。

talk: wikinews:2009 Shri Shyam Bhajan Hindu religious festival held in Hyderabad
title: 2009 Shri Shyam Bhajan Hindu religious festival held in Hyderabad
en: Lakkha Singh presented the chhappan bhog bhajan as well. Singer, Raju Khandelwal was accompanying him.
zh: 拉卡·辛格 (Lakkha Singh) 还介绍了 chhappan bhog bhajan。歌手 Raju Khandelwal 陪同他身边。

talk: wikinews:Jenson Button wins 2006 Hungarian Grand Prix
title: Jenson Button wins 2006 Hungarian Grand Prix
en: Giancarlo Fisichella lost control of his car and ended the race very soon after the start.
zh: 詹卡洛·费斯切拉因失去了对赛车的把控，在比赛开始后不久就退出了。

talk: wikinews:Jenson Button wins 2006 Hungarian Grand Prix
title: Jenson Button wins 2006 Hungarian Grand Prix
en: His teammate Fernando Alonso was in the lead for most of the race, but ended it right after his pit-stop, probably because a badly tucked right front wheel.
zh: 他的队友费尔南多·阿隆索（Fernando Alonso）在比赛中的绝大多数时间里都处于领先地位，但却在进站后就退出了比赛，大概是因为其右前轮实在塞得厉害。

talk: wikinews:Jenson Button wins 2006 Hungarian Grand Prix

en: Out of 1,400 people polled prior to the 2010 federal election, those who oppose Australia becoming a republic grew by 8 per cent since 2008.
zh: 在 2010 年联邦大选之前曾对 1,400 名受访者做过调查，受访者中反对澳大利亚成为共和国的人数自 2008 年以来增长了 8%。

talk: wikinews:Support for an Australian republic slips
title: Support for an Australian republic slips
en: Caretaker Prime Minister Julia Gillard claimed during the campaign of the 2010 federal election that she believed Australia should become a republic at the end of Queen Elizabeth II's reign.
zh: 看守总理朱莉娅·吉拉德在2010年联邦大选竞选期间称，她认为在女王伊丽莎白二世退位后，澳大利亚应该成为共和国。

talk: wikinews:Support for an Australian republic slips
title: Support for an Australian republic slips
en: 34 per cent of those in the poll share this view, wanting Queen Elizabeth II to be Australia's last monarch.
zh: 34% 的受访者一致表示，希望英国女王伊丽莎白二世成为澳大利亚的最后一任君主。

talk: wikinews:Support for an Australian republic slips
title: Support for an Australian republic slips
en: At the extremes of the poll, 29 per cent of those surveyed believe Australia should become a republic as soon as possible, while 31 per cent believe Australia should never become a republic.
zh: 投票存在两极分化的情况，29% 的受访者认为澳大利亚应该尽快成立共和国，31% 的人则认为澳大利亚永远不应该成立共和国。

talk: wikinews:Ian Thorpe starts to recover from chest pains
title: Ian Thorpe starts to recover from chest pains
en: The Olympic gold medalist was due to swim in the 100m and 200m freestyle and in three relays at the Commonwealth Games, but due to his complaints his fitness has been in doubt.
zh: 这位奥运会金牌得主本应参加 100 米和 200 米自由泳和英联邦运动会的三项接力赛，但由于他的抱怨，他的健康状况一直受到质疑。

talk: wikinews:Ian Thorpe starts to recover from chest pains
title: Ian Thorpe starts to recover from chest pains
en: He has been unable to take the drugs needed to overcome his pain as they are banned from the Games.
zh: 他一直无法用药物来缓解疼痛，因为比赛禁止参赛者服用这些药物。

talk: wikinews:Philae space probe lands on comet
title: Philae space probe lands on comet
en: Comets may possibly have been a source of water delivery to the earth along with organic matter that can form proteins and support life.
zh: 彗星可能是地球上的水和有机物的来源，这些有机物可以形成蛋白质并维持生命的存续。

talk: wikinews:Philae space probe lands on comet
title: Philae space probe lands on comet
en: Scientists hope to understand how planets form, especially how the Earth formed, since comets collided with the Earth long ago.
zh: 科学家希望了解自从彗星很久以前与地球相撞以来，行星是如何形成的，尤其是地球的形成方式。

talk: wikinews:Despite speculation, aides say Biden will remain on Obama ticket
title: Despite speculation, aides say Biden will remain on Obama ticket
en: Cuomo, 53, began his governorship earlier this year and signed a bill last month legalizing same-sex marriage.
zh: 现年 53 岁的库莫（Cuomo）从今年年初开始担任州长，并于上个月签署了一项将同性婚姻合法化的法案。

talk: wikinews:Despite speculation, aides say Biden will remain on Obama ticket
title: Despite speculation, aides say Biden will remain on Obama ticket
en: He referred to the rumors as "political chatter and silliness".
zh: 他把谣言称为“政治碎碎念和愚蠢行为”。

talk: wikinews:Despite speculation, aides say Biden will remain on Obama ticket
title: Despite speculation, aides say Biden will remain on Obama ticket
en: He is speculated to make a run for president in 2016.
zh: 据推测，他将在 2016 年参加总统竞选。

talk: wikinews:Researchers report rapid formation of new bird species in Galápagos islands
title: Researchers report rapid formation of new bird species in Galápagos islands
en: A study published on Thursday in the journal Science reported on formation of a new bird species on the Ecuadorean Galápagos Islands.
zh: 周四，一份发表于《科学》杂志的研究报告称，一种新的鸟类在厄瓜多尔加拉帕戈斯群岛形成。

talk: wikinews:Researchers report rapid formation of new bird species in Galápagos islands
title: Researchers report rapid formation of new bird species in Galápagos islands
en: Researchers from Princeton University in the United States and Uppsala University in Sweden reported the new species evolved in just two generations, though this process had been believed to take much longer, due to breeding between an endemic Darwin finch, Geospiza fortes, and the immigrant cactus finch, Geospiza conirostris.
zh: 来自美国普林斯顿大学和瑞典乌普萨拉大学的研究人员报告称，由于当地特有的达尔文雀中的勇地雀和外来的仙人掌大嘴地雀之间的繁殖，这个新物种只进化了两代，尽管人们认为这一过程需要更长的时间。

talk: wikibooks:Wikijunior:Big Book of Fun Science Experiments/Red cabbage indicator
title: Wikijunior:Big Book of Fun Science Experiments/Red cabbage indicator
en: This is called a chemical's pH. You can make an indicator using red cabbage juice.
zh: 这被称为化学物质的 pH 值。你可以使用红甘蓝汁制作指示剂。

talk: wikibooks:Wikijunior:Big Book of Fun Science Experiments/Red cabbage indicator
title: Wikijunior:Big Book of Fun Science Experiments/Red cabbage indicator
en: The cabbage juice changes color depending on how acidic or basic (alkaline) the chemical is.
zh: 卷心菜汁的颜色将根据化学物质的酸碱性发生变化。

talk: wikibooks:Wikijunior:Big Book of Fun Science Experiments/Red cabbage indicator
title: Wikijunior:Big Book of Fun Science Experiments/Red cabbage indicator
en: The pH level is indicated by the amount of Hydrogen (the H in pH) ions in the tested chemical.
zh: pH 值以被测化学品中的氢（pH 中的 H）离子数量表示。

talk: wikibooks:Wikijunior:Big Book of Fun Science Experiments/Red cabbage indicator
title: Wikijunior:Big Book of Fun Science Experiments/Red cabbage indicator
en: Hydrogen ions are protons that had their electrons stripped off them (since Hydrogen atoms consist of one proton and one electron).
zh: 氢离子是失去了电子的质子（因为氢原子由一个质子和一个电子组成）。

talk: wikibooks:Wikijunior:Big Book of Fun Science Experiments/How A Bath Fizzer Works, and How To Make One
title: Wikijunior:Big Book of Fun Science Experiments/How A Bath Fizzer Works, and How To Make One
en: Swirl the two dry powders together and then, with clean wet hands, squeeze them into a ball.
zh: 搅动两种干粉使其混合，然后用干净的湿手把它们揉成一个球。

talk: wikibooks:Wikijunior:Big Book of Fun Science Experiments/How A Bath Fizzer Works, and How To Make One
title: Wikijunior:Big Book of Fun Science Experiments/How A Bath Fizzer Works, and How To Make One
en: The moisture on your hands will react with the outer layers, which will feel funny and form a sort of shell.
zh: 你手上的水分会与外层发生反应，这样会形成一层类似外壳的东西，感觉十分有趣。

title: Wikijunior:How Things Work/Rocket
en: When you call someone who is thousands of miles away, you are using a satellite.
zh: 你给远在千里之外的人打电话，就会用到卫星。

title: Wikijunior:How Things Work/Rocket
en: The satellite in space gets the call and then reflects it back down, almost instantly.
zh: 太空中的卫星接到电话后，几乎是立刻将其反射回去。

title: Wikijunior:How Things Work/Rocket
en: The satellite was sent into space by a rocket. Scientists use telescopes in space because the Earth’s atmosphere distorts some of our light and view.
zh: 卫星是由火箭发射到太空的。科学家在太空中使用望远镜是因为地球的大气层让某些光线和视野产生扭曲。

title: Wikijunior:How Things Work/Rocket
en: It takes a giant rocket over a 100 feet high to put a satellite or telescope in space.
zh: 要把卫星或望远镜送入太空，需要一枚超过 100 英尺高的巨型火箭。

title: Wikijunior:How Things Work/Wheel
en: The wheel has changed the world in incredible ways. The biggest thing that the wheel has done for us is given us much easier and faster transportation.
zh: 车轮以不可思议的方式改变了世界。车轮对我们最大的贡献，是让我们的交通更加便捷。

title: Wikijunior:How Things Work/Wheel
en: It has brought us the train, the car, and many other transportation devices.
zh: 有了它，我们才有了火车、汽车和许多其他交通工具。

title: Wikijunior:Big Cats/Meet The Cats
en: Under them are more medium sized cats that eat medium sized prey ranging from rabbits to antelopes and deer.
zh: 它们的下方是更多中等大小的猫科动物，它们吃的是中等大小的猎物，从兔子、羚羊到鹿都会吃。

title: Wikijunior:Big Cats/Meet The Cats
en: Finally, there are many small cats (including loose pet cats) that eat the far more numerous small prey like insects, rodents, lizards, and birds.
zh: 最终，有许多小型的猫科动物（包括散养的宠物猫），以昆虫、啮齿动物、蜥蜴和鸟类等数量多得多的小型猎物为食。

title: Wikijunior:Big Cats/Meet The Cats
en: The secret to their success is the concept of the niche, a special job each cat holds that keeps it from competing with others.
zh: 它们成功的秘诀是利基概念，每只猫都负责一项特殊的工作，防止它们与其他猫竞争。

title: Wikijunior:Big Cats/Lion
en: Lions are the most social cats, living in large groups called prides.
zh: 狮子是群居属性最明显的猫科动物，生活在称为狮群的大型群体中。

title: Wikijunior:Big Cats/Lion
en: Prides are made up of one to three related adult males, along with as many as thirty females and cubs.
zh: 狮群由一到三只有亲属关系的成年雄性，以及可多达三十只的雌性和幼崽组成。

title: Wikijunior:Big Cats/Lion
en: The females are usually closely related to each other, being a large family of sisters and daughters.
zh: 作为大家庭里的姐妹和女儿，雌性之间通常彼此关系密切。

title: Wikijunior:Big Cats/Lion
en: Lion prides act much like packs of wolves or dogs, animals surprisingly similar to lions (but not other big cats) in behavior, and also very deadly to their prey.
zh: 狮群的行为与狼群或狗群非常类似。这些动物与狮子的行为惊人地相似（但与其他大型猫科动物不同），而且这些行为对它们的猎物来说也是非常致命的。

title: Wikijunior:Big Cats/Tiger
en: A well rounded athlete, the tiger can climb (though not well), swim, leap great distances and pull with five times the force of a strong human.
zh: 老虎是全能运动员，它会攀爬（虽然攀爬能力不是很强）、游泳、跳远，拉力能达到人类大力士的五倍。

title: Wikijunior:Big Cats/Tiger
en: The tiger is in the same group (Genus Panthera) as lions, leopards, and jaguars. These four cats are the only ones who can roar.
zh: 老虎与狮、豹和美洲虎属于同一类型（豹属）。这四种大猫是仅有的会吼叫的猫科动物。

title: Wikijunior:Big Cats/Tiger
en: The tiger's roar is not like the full-voiced roar of a lion, but more like a sentence of snarly, shouted words.
zh: 老虎的咆哮不像狮子的咆哮那样深沉，而更像一句生气嘶吼的话语。

title: Wikijunior:Big Cats/Ocelot
en: Ocelots like to eat small animals. They will catch monkeys, snakes, rodents and birds if they can. Almost all of the animals that the ocelot hunts are far smaller than it is.
zh: 豹猫喜欢吃小动物。如果条件允许，他们会捕捉猴子、蛇、啮齿动物和鸟类。豹猫的猎物几乎都比自身要小得多。

title: Wikijunior:Big Cats/Ocelot
en: Scientists think that ocelots follow and find animals to eat (prey) by smell, sniffing for where they've been on the ground.
zh: 科学家认为，美洲豹猫是通过气味和嗅探猎物在地面上的踪迹来跟踪和寻找要捕食的动物的。

title: Wikijunior:Big Cats/Ocelot
en: They can see very well in the dark with night vision, and move very stealthily, too. Ocelots hunt their prey by blending in with their surroundings then pouncing on their prey.
zh: 它们的夜视能力很强，能在黑暗中看得很清楚，而且行动也很隐秘。豹猫的捕食方式是先融入周围环境，然后猛扑向猎物。

title: Wikijunior:Biology/Origin of Life
en: When a small group of living things (a small population) gets separated from the main population that they came from (like if they move over a mountain range or a river, or if they move to a new island so that they can't easily move back) they will often find themselves in a different environment than they were in before.
zh: 当一小群生物（一个小种群）与它们本来的主要种群分离时（比如它们跨过山脉和河流，或者它们到了一个新的岛屿以至于不可能轻易回去)，它们通常会发现自己所处的环境与之前不同。

title: Wikijunior:Biology/Origin of Life
en: This new environment has different resources and different competitors, so the new population will need different features or adaptations to be a strong competitor than what they had needed before.
zh: 这个新的环境有不同的资源和不同的竞争对手，所以新的种群将需要不同的特征或适应能力来成为一个强有力的竞争对手，而不是它们之前所需要的那些。

title: Wikijunior:Biology/Origin of Life
en: The original population hasn't changed at all, they still need the same adaptations as before.
zh: 原来的种群根本没有改变，它们仍需要和以前一样适应环境。

title: Wikijunior:Biology/Origin of Life
en: Over time, as the new population begins to adapt to their new environment, they start to look less and less like the other population.
zh: 随着时间的推移，新的种群开始适应新的环境，它们开始变得与其他种群越来越不相似了。

title: Wikijunior:Biology/Origin of Life
en: Eventually, after thousands or even millions of years, the two populations will look so different that they can't be called the same species.
zh: 在历经数千甚至数百万年以后，这两个种群最终看上去会截然不同，以致于不能将两者称作同一物种。

title: Wikijunior:Biology/Origin of Life
en: We call this process speciation, which just means the formation of new species. Speciation is an unavoidable consequence and a very important part of evolution.
zh: 我们把这个过程称为“物种形成”，也就是新物种的形成。物种形成是进化的必然结果，也是进化中极为重要的一环。

title: Wikijunior:Biology/Kingdoms/Plants
en: Plants make oxygen which humans breathe, and they take in carbon-dioxide which humans exhale (that is, breathe out).
zh: 植物能制造人类吸入的氧气，吸收人类呼出的二氧化碳。

title: Wikijunior:Biology/Kingdoms/Plants
en: Plants make their food from the sun by photosynthesis. They also provide shade.
zh: 植物通过光合作用从阳光中获取养分。它们还能提供荫凉。

title: Wikijunior:Biology/Kingdoms/Plants
en: We make our houses from plants and make clothes from plants. Most foods that we eat are plants. Without plants, animals could not survive.
zh: 我们用植物做房子，用植物做衣服。我们吃的大部分食物都是植物。没有植物，动物就不能生存。

title: Wikijunior:Dinosaurs/Mosasaurus
en: Mosasaurus was the apex predator of its time, so it feared nothing, except other mosasaurs.
zh: 沧龙是那个时代的顶级掠食者，除了同类它什么都不怕。

title: Wikijunior:Dinosaurs/Mosasaurus
en: Its long jaws were studded with more than 70 razor-sharp teeth, along with an extra set in the roof of its mouth, meaning that there was no escape for anything that crossed its path.
zh: 它的长下颚上布满了 70 多颗剃刀般锋利的牙齿，上颚上还有一排。这意味着任何与它相遇的东西都无路可逃。

title: Wikijunior:Dinosaurs/Mosasaurus
en: We don't know for sure, but it may have had a forked tongue. Its diet included turtles, large fish, other mosasaurs, and it may even have been a cannibal.
zh: 它的舌头有可能是分叉的，对此我们尚不确定。它的食物包括海龟、大型鱼类、其他沧龙，甚至会吃人。

title: Wikijunior:Dinosaurs/Mosasaurus
en: It also attacked anything that entered the water; even a giant dinosaur such as T. rex would be no match for it.
zh: 它会攻击任何进入水中的东西；即使像霸王龙之类的巨型恐龙也不是它的对手。

title: Wikijunior:Ancient Civilizations/Romans
en: While most of their food would be familiar to us, Romans did have their share of strange or unusual feast items, including wild boar, peacock, snails, and a type of rodent called a dormouse
zh: 尽管罗马人的大部分食物是我们所常见的，但他们确实有一些奇怪或不寻常的宴会菜肴，包括野猪、孔雀、蜗牛和一种叫做榛睡鼠的啮齿动物

title: Wikijunior:Ancient Civilizations/Romans
en: Another difference was that while the poor people and the woman ate their food while sitting in chairs, the rich men liked to have banquets together where they would lounge on their sides while they ate their meals.
zh: 另一个不同之处在于，穷人和女人坐在椅子上吃饭，富人则喜欢聚在一起举行宴会，侧卧着吃饭。

title: Wikijunior:Ancient Civilizations/Romans
en: Ancient Roman meals couldn't have included foods that came to Europe from America or from Asia in later centuries.
zh: 几个世纪后从美洲或亚洲传入欧洲的食物不可能出现在古罗马人的饮食当中。

title: Wikijunior:Ancient Civilizations/Romans
en: For instance, they didn't have corn, nor tomatoes, nor potatoes, nor cocoa, and no ancient Roman ever tasted a turkey.
zh: 例如，他们没有玉米、西红柿、土豆和可可，也没有哪个古罗马人吃过火鸡。

title: Wikijunior:Ancient Civilizations/Hebrews
en: In the warm climate of the Middle East, the house was not so important.
zh: 在中东温暖的气候中，房子并不是多重要。

title: Wikijunior:Ancient Civilizations/Hebrews
en: Most of the life of the Hebrew family happened in the open air.
zh: 希伯来家庭的生活大多是在户外度过的。

title: Wikijunior:Ancient Civilizations/Hebrews
en: Women did the cooking in the yard; stores were just open counters looking into the street. Stone was used for building houses.
zh: 女人们在院子里做饭；商店其实就是面向街道的开放柜台。他们用石头来建造房屋。

title: Wikijunior:Ancient Civilizations/Hebrews
en: There were no large forests in the land of Canaan, so wood was extremely expensive.
zh: 迦南没有大森林，所以木材非常昂贵。

title: Wikijunior:Ancient Civilizations/Norse
en: Greenland was settled sparsely. In the Norse sagas they say that Erik the Red was exiled from Iceland for murder, and when travelling further west, found Greenland and named it Greenland.
zh: 格陵兰岛人烟稀少。据北欧史诗萨迦记载，红胡子埃里克因犯谋杀罪被逐出冰岛，他向西航行，发现陆地，于是将其命名为格陵兰岛。

title: Wikijunior:Ancient Civilizations/Norse
en: But regardless of his discovery, Eskimo tribes were already living there at the time.
zh: 但不管他有没有发现，爱斯基摩人当时已经在那里生活了。

title: Wikijunior:Ancient Civilizations/Norse
en: Though each country was 'Scandinavian', there were many differences between the people, kings, customs and history of Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Iceland.
zh: 虽然均隶属于“斯堪的纳维亚”，但丹麦、瑞典、挪威和冰岛的民众、国王、习俗和历史之间存在着许多差异。

talk: wikibooks:Wikijunior:United States Charters of Freedom/Declaration of Independence
title: Wikijunior:United States Charters of Freedom/Declaration of Independence
en: If you have watched the movie National Treasure, you may think a treasure map was written on the back of the Declaration of Independence.
zh: 如果你看过电影《国家宝藏》，你可能会以为《独立宣言》背面会画着一份藏宝图。

talk: wikibooks:Wikijunior:United States Charters of Freedom/Declaration of Independence
title: Wikijunior:United States Charters of Freedom/Declaration of Independence
en: However, that is not true. Although there is something written on the back of the document, it is not a treasure map.
zh: 然而事实并非如此。虽然这份文件的背面写了一些东西，但并是不一份藏宝图。

talk: wikibooks:Wikijunior:United States Charters of Freedom/Declaration of Independence
title: Wikijunior:United States Charters of Freedom/Declaration of Independence
en: Written on the back of the Declaration of Independence were the words "Original Declaration of Independence dated 4th July 1776". The text appears on the bottom of the document, upside down.
zh: 《独立宣言》背面写着“Original Declaration of Independence dated 4th July 1776（《独立宣言》原件，1776 年 7 月 4 日）”的字样。文字写在文件底部，是倒过来的。

talk: wikibooks:Wikijunior:United States Charters of Freedom/Declaration of Independence
title: Wikijunior:United States Charters of Freedom/Declaration of Independence
en: While no one knows for certain who wrote it, it is known that early in its life, the large parchment document (it measures 29¾ inches by 24½ inches) was rolled up for storage.
zh: 虽然没有人能确定作者是谁，但这个大型羊皮纸文档（尺寸为 29¾ 英寸乘以 24½ 英寸）据称在刚写成的时候是卷起来存放的。

talk: wikibooks:Wikijunior:United States Charters of Freedom/Declaration of Independence
title: Wikijunior:United States Charters of Freedom/Declaration of Independence
en: So, it is likely that the notation was added simply as a label.
zh: 因此，很可能这个符号只是作为一个标签添加的。

talk: wikibooks:Wikijunior:World War II/Liberation of Western Europe
title: Wikijunior:World War II/Liberation of Western Europe
en: The D-Day landings and the following battles had freed the north of France, but the south still wasn't free.
zh: 诺曼底登陆和随后的战斗解放了法国北部，但南部仍然没有解放。

talk: wikibooks:Wikijunior:World War II/Liberation of Western Europe
title: Wikijunior:World War II/Liberation of Western Europe
en: It was ruled by the "Vichy" French. These were French people who had made peace with the Germans in 1940 and worked with the invaders instead of fighting them.
zh: 它由“维希”法国人统治。这些法国人在 1940 年与德国人达成了和平协议，不反抗侵略者，而是和他们合作。

talk: wikibooks:Wikijunior:World War II/Liberation of Western Europe
title: Wikijunior:World War II/Liberation of Western Europe
en: On 15 August 1940, the Allies invaded southern France, the invasion was called "Operation Dragoon".
zh: 1940 年 8 月 15 日，盟军攻入法国南部，这次进攻被称为“龙骑兵行动”。

talk: wikibooks:Wikijunior:World War II/Liberation of Western Europe
title: Wikijunior:World War II/Liberation of Western Europe
en: In just two weeks the Americans and Free French forces had liberated southern France and were turning towards Germany.
zh: 仅仅两个星期，美国和自由法国的军队就解放了法国南部，并转向德国。

title: Wikijunior:Ancient Civilizations/What is a Civilization?
en: A civilization is a singular culture shared by a significant large group of people who live and work co-operatively, a society.
zh: 文明是一种由共同生活、合作工作的人群（社会）所共享的单一文化。

title: Wikijunior:Ancient Civilizations/What is a Civilization?
en: The word civilization comes from the Latin civilis, meaning civil, related to the Latin civis, meaning citizen, and civitas, meaning city or city-state, and that also somehow defines the size of the society.
zh: “文明”一词来自拉丁语“civilis”（意为“公民的”），与拉丁语"civis"（意为“公民”）及"civitas"（意为“城市”或“城邦”）都有关，这也以某种方式定义了社会的规模。

title: Wikijunior:Ancient Civilizations/What is a Civilization?
en: City-states are the precursors of nations. A civilizational culture implies the passing on of knowledge across several generations, a lingering cultural footprint and fair dissemination.
zh: 城邦是民族的前身。文明型文化意味着知识的代代相传，文化的足迹萦绕留存，还有文化能够公平地传播。

title: Wikijunior:Ancient Civilizations/What is a Civilization?
en: Minor cultures often vanish without leaving relevant historic evidence and fail to be recognized as proper civilizations.
zh: 少数民族文化常常没有留下相关的历史证据就消失无踪，而且不被当做是像样的文明。

title: Wikijunior:United States Charters of Freedom/Constitution
en: During the Revolutionary War, the thirteen states first formed a weak central government—with the Congress being its only component—under the Articles of Confederation.
zh: 在独立战争期间，十三个州最初根据《联邦条例》组成了弱小的中央政府（国会是其唯一的组成部分）。

title: Wikijunior:United States Charters of Freedom/Constitution
en: Congress lacked any power to impose taxes, and, because there was no national executive or judiciary, it relied on state authorities, who were often uncooperative, to enforce all its acts.
zh: 国会没有征税的权力，而且因为没有国家行政部门或司法部门，国会只能依赖州政府执行所有法案，而州政府又经常不配合。

title: Wikijunior:United States Charters of Freedom/Constitution
en: It also had no authority to override tax laws and tariffs between states.
zh: 它也没有权力推翻各州之间的税法和关税。

title: Wikijunior:United States Charters of Freedom/Constitution
en: The Articles required unanimous consent from all the states before they could be amended and states took the central government so lightly that their representatives were often absent.
zh: 这些条款必须得到所有州的一致同意才能进行修改，而各州对待中央政府的态度十分轻慢，以至于其州立代表经常缺席。

title: Wikijunior:Europe/Italy
en: Italy's national football, along with German national football team is the second most successful team in the world and were the FIFA World Cup champions in 2006.
zh: 意大利国家足球队和德国国家足球队都是世界上第二成功的球队，在 2006 年拿下了足球世界杯冠军。

title: Wikijunior:Europe/Italy
en: Popular sports include football, basketball, volleyball, water-polo, fencing, rugby, cycling, ice hockey, roller hockey and F1 motor racing.
zh: 流行的运动项目包括足球、篮球、排球、水球、击剑、橄榄球、自行车、冰球、轮滑曲棍球和一级方程式赛车。

title: Wikijunior:Europe/Italy
en: Winter sports are most popular in the Northern regions, with Italians competing in international games and Olympic events.
zh: 冬季运动在北部地区最受欢迎，意大利人会在那里参加国际比赛和奥运会比赛。

title: Wikijunior:Asia/Japan
en: Japans holds nearly 7,000 islands (the biggest being Honshu), making Japan the 7th largest island in the world!
zh: 日本拥有近 7000 个岛屿（最大的是本州岛），这让日本成为了世界第七大岛国！

title: Wikijunior:Asia/Japan
en: Due to the cluster/group of islands Japan has, Japan is often referred to, on a geographical stance, as an "archipelago"
zh: 由于日本的岛屿群众多，日本从地质学角度上常被称为“列岛”

title: Wikijunior:World Heritage Sites/Machu Picchu
en: Machu Picchu consist of three main structures, namely Intihuatana, the Temple of the Sun, and the Room of the Three Windows.
zh: 马丘比丘古城由三座主要建筑物组成，分别是拴日石 (Intihuatana)、太阳神庙和三窗之屋。

title: Wikijunior:World Heritage Sites/Machu Picchu
en: Most of the buildings on the edges of the complex have been rebuilt in order to give tourists a better idea of how they originally appeared.
zh: 为了让游客更好地了解建筑群的原貌，该建筑群边缘的大部分建筑都经过重建。

title: Wikijunior:World Heritage Sites/Machu Picchu
en: By 1976, thirty percent of Machu Picchu had been restored and restoration continues till today.
zh: 到 1976 年，马丘比丘的百分之三十得到修复，修复工作一直持续到今天。

title: Modern Photography/Format
en: For example, the most common still image photography format in the world is 35mm, which was the dominant film size at the close of the analog film era.
zh: 例如，世界上最常见的静态图像摄影格式是 35mm 格式，这是胶片电影时代末期占主导地位的电影尺寸。

title: Modern Photography/Format
en: It is still produced today, but more importantly its aspect ratio has been inherited by digital camera image sensor formats.
zh: 时至今日仍有生产，但更重要的是它的长宽比应用到了数码相机图像传感器的格式上。

title: Modern Photography/Format
en: The 35mm format is actually, somewhat confusingly, 36mm in width by 24mm in height.
zh: 35 毫米格式的实际尺寸是 36 毫米宽，24 毫米高，这样格式其实有点令人困惑。

title: Modern Photography/Format
en: The aspect ratio of this format (dividing by twelve to obtain the simplest whole-number ratio) is therefore said to be 3:2.
zh: 因此，这种格式的宽高比（除以 12 得到最简单的整数比）便是 3:2。

title: Modern Photography/Format
en: Many common formats (APS family of formats, for example) are equal to or closely approximate this aspect ratio.
zh: 许多常见格式（例如 APS 格式系列）都与这个长宽比相同或相当接近。

title: Modern Photography/Composition
en: The much-abused and often-ridiculed rule of thirds is a simple guideline creating dynamism while keeping a measure of order in an image.
zh: 经常被滥用和嘲笑的三分法，在创造动态时不失为一种简单的指导方法，还能让图像保持有序。

title: Modern Photography/Composition
en: It states that the most effective place for the main subject is at the intersection of lines dividing the image into thirds vertically and horizontally (see example).
zh: 它指出，对主体来说最有效的位置是将图像垂直和水平分为三部分的线的交叉点（见示例）。

title: European History/Challenges to Spiritual Authority
en: During this period of European history, the Catholic Church, which had become rich and powerful, came under scrutiny.
zh: 在欧洲历史上的这段时期，已然富有而强大起来的天主教会受到了密切监督。

title: European History/Challenges to Spiritual Authority
en: For over a thousand years the Christian religion had bound European states together despite differences in language and customs. I
zh: 尽管欧洲各国语言和习俗各不相同，但一千多年来，基督教把它们联系在了一起。

title: European History/Challenges to Spiritual Authority
en: Its all-pervading power affected everyone from king to commoner.
zh: 从国王到平民，它遍布十方的力量影响着每一个人。

title: European History/Challenges to Spiritual Authority
en: One of the main Christian tenets is that wealth should be used to alleviate suffering and poverty and that the monetary funds of the church are there specifically for that reason.
zh: 基督教的主要信条之一是财富应该用来减轻痛苦和贫困，而教会的货币基金就是专门为此而设立的。

title: European History/Challenges to Spiritual Authority
en: The central authority of the church had been in Rome for over a thousand years and this concentration of power and money led many to question whether this tenet was being met.
zh: 教会中央集权制在罗马存在了一千多年，这种权力和金钱的集中让许多人开始质疑，他们是否遵守了这一信条。

title: European History/World War I
en: Soon after the outbreak of hostilities, Britain initiated a naval blockade of Germany.
zh: 敌对行动爆发后不久，英国开始对德国实施海上封锁。

title: European History/World War I
en: The strategy proved effective, cutting off vital military and civilian supplies, although this blockade violated generally accepted international law codified by several international agreements of the past two centuries.
zh: 他们切断了生死攸关的军事和民用物资供应。事实证明这一战略是有效的，尽管这样的封锁违反了在过去的两个世纪里，根据几项国际协定制定的已为大家普遍接受的国际法。

title: European History/World War I
en: Britain mined international waters to prevent any ships from entering entire sections of ocean, causing danger to even neutral ships.
zh: 英国在国际水域布雷，防止任何船只进入整片海域，甚至对中立国船只也构成威胁。

title: European History/World War I
en: Since there was limited response to this tactic, Germany expected a similar response to its unrestricted submarine warfare.
zh: 因为对这一战略的响应有限，德国期望其无限制潜艇战也能有类似的响应。

title: European History/Europe: 1918 to 1945
en: During the 1920s, the prevailing attitudes of most citizens and nations was that of pacifism and isolation.
zh: 在 20 世纪 20 年代，大多市民的主流态度是和平主义的、分离主义的。

title: European History/Europe: 1918 to 1945
en: After seeing the horrors and atrocities of war during World War I, nations desired to avoid such a situation again in the future.
zh: 目睹第一次世界大战中的肆虐残暴后，各国都渴望避免重蹈覆辙。

title: Ancient China/Government
en: Ancient China had a unique way of showing different time periods; each stage of China or each family that was in power was a distinctive dynasty.
zh: 中国古代的不同时期各有特点；中国的每个时期或每个执掌天下的家族都是一个特点鲜明的王朝。

title: Ancient China/Government
en: Also between each dynasty was an unstable age of divided provinces. The best-known of these periods was the Three Kingdoms epoch taking place for 60 years between the Han and the Jin Dynasty.
zh: 同样，历朝历代更迭期间都是一段小国分立的不稳定时代。其中最有名的便是长达 60 年的三国时期，该时期处于汉晋两代的更迭之间。

title: Ancient China/Government
en: During these periods fierce warfare took place between many nobles fighting for the throne.
zh: 在这些动乱时期，各路诸侯为争夺王位而发生激烈战争。

title: Ancient China/Government
en: The Three Kingdoms was one of the bloodiest eras in Ancient China’s history thousands of people died fighting to sit in the highest seat in the grand palace at Xi’an.
zh: 三国是中国古代历史上最血腥的时代之一。成千上万的人为了争夺西安豪华宫殿最高的权力而死去。

title: French Revolution/Effects
en: There are a lot of social and political effects such as the use of metric system, a shift from absolutism to republicanism, nationalism and the belief the country belongs to the people not to one sole ruler.
zh: 还有许多社会和政治影响，例如度量单位的使用、从专制到共和制的转变、民族主义、相信国家不属于唯一的统治者而是属于人民。

title: French Revolution/Effects
en: Also after the Revolution occupations were open to all male applicants allowing the most ambitious and successful to succeed.
zh: 此外，在革命之后，官职面向全体男性开放申请，这使得最有抱负、最成功之人有机会飞黄腾达。

title: French Revolution/Effects
en: Same goes for the military because instead of army rankings being based on class they were now based on cailaber.
zh: 军队亦然，因为军衔的高低不再基于等级，而是基于才干。

title: French Revolution/Effects
en: The French Revolution also inspired many other repressed working class people of other country's to began their own revolutions.
zh: 法国大革命也鼓舞了许多其他国家被压迫的工人阶级，开始他们自己的革命。

title: History of Islam/Early Islam
en: Muhammad was deeply interested in matters beyond this mundane life. He used to frequent a cave that became known as “Hira‘” on the Mountain of “Noor” (light) for contemplation.
zh: 穆罕默德对尘世生活之外的事十分感兴趣。他以前经常到“努尔”（光明）山上一个叫做”希拉“的山洞里去冥想。

title: History of Islam/Early Islam
en: he cave itself, which survived the times, gives a very vivid image of Muhammad’s spiritual inclinations.
zh: 该洞穴本身，不仅经受住时间考验而保留下来，还为穆罕默德的灵性意向带来极其生动的形象。

title: History of Islam/Early Islam
en: Resting on the top of one of the mountains north of Mecca, the cave is completely isolated from the rest of the world.
zh: 该洞穴坐落在麦加 (Mecca) 北部的一座山顶上，与外界完全隔绝。

title: History of Islam/Early Islam
en: In fact, it is not easy to find at all even if one knew it existed. Once inside the cave, it is a total isolation.
zh: 事实上，即使知道它的存在，也不容易找到。一旦进入洞穴，就完全与世隔绝了。

title: History of Islam/Early Islam
en: Nothing can be seen other than the clear, beautiful sky above and the many surrounding mountains. Very little of this world can be seen or heard from inside the cave.
zh: 除了清澈美丽的天空和周围的群山，什么也看不见。在洞穴中，几乎看不到也听不到外界的景象和声音。

talk: wikibooks:The Seven Wonders of the World/The Great Pyramid
topic: seven wonders of the world/pyramid at giza
title: The Seven Wonders of the World/The Great Pyramid
en: The Great Pyramid at Giza is the only one of the seven wonders that is still standing today.
zh: 吉萨大金字塔是七大奇迹中唯一至今仍屹立不倒的建筑。

talk: wikibooks:The Seven Wonders of the World/The Great Pyramid
topic: seven wonders of the world/pyramid at giza
title: The Seven Wonders of the World/The Great Pyramid
en: Built by the Egyptians in the third century BCE, the Great Pyramid is one of many large pyramid structures built to honor dead Pharaoh.
zh: 大金字塔是埃及人在公元前三世纪的杰作，它是众多向已故法老表示敬意的大型金字塔的其中之一。

talk: wikibooks:The Seven Wonders of the World/The Great Pyramid
topic: seven wonders of the world/pyramid at giza
title: The Seven Wonders of the World/The Great Pyramid
en: The Giza Plateau, or "Giza Necropolis" in the Egyptian Valley of the Dead contains several pyramids (of which the great pyramid is the largest), several small tombs, several temples, and the great Sphinx.
zh: 埃及死亡之谷的吉萨（Giza）高原（即“吉萨金字塔群”）包括多个金字塔（其中大金字塔是最大的）、几个小坟墓，几个寺庙和大狮身人面像。

talk: wikibooks:The Seven Wonders of the World/The Great Pyramid
topic: seven wonders of the world/pyramid at giza
title: The Seven Wonders of the World/The Great Pyramid
en: The great pyramid was created to honor the Pharaoh Khufu, and many of the smaller pyramids, tombs, and temples were built to honor Khufu's wives and family members.
zh: 大金字塔是为纪念胡夫法老而建造的，并为纪念胡夫的妻子和家庭成员建造了多座较小的金字塔、坟墓和庙宇。

title: European History/Revolution in France
en: The terrified King Louis XVI, Queen Marie Antoinette their two young children (11 year old Marie Therese and four year old Louis-Charles) and the King's sister, Madam Elizabeth, on the 6th October 1789 were forced back to Paris from Versailles by a mob of market women.
zh: 在 1789 年 10 月 6 日，受到惊吓的国王路易十六、王后玛丽·安托瓦内特和他们的两个孩子（11 岁的玛丽·特蕾莎和 4 岁的路易斯·查尔斯），以及国王的妹妹伊丽莎白夫人，被一群集市妇女从凡尔赛赶回了巴黎。

title: European History/Revolution in France
en: In a carriage, they traveled back to Paris surrounded by a mob of people screaming and shouting threats against the King and Queen.
zh: 他们乘坐马车回到了巴黎，一群人包围了他们，大喊大叫地威胁国王和王后。

title: European History/Revolution in France
en: The mob of people forced the King And Queen to have their carriage windows wide open.
zh: 暴民强迫国王和王后把马车的窗户完全打开。

title: European History/Revolution in France
en: At one point a member of the mob waved the head of a royal guard killed at Versailles in front of the terrified Queen.
zh: 当着吓坏了的女王的面，有一名暴徒一度挥动一颗皇家卫士的头颅，这名卫士是在凡尔赛宫被杀害的。

title: Philippine History/The Philippine-American War
en: The war expenditures of U.S. imperialism in the conquest of the Philippines were paid for by the Filipino people themselves.
zh: 美帝国主义在征服菲律宾时的战争开支是由菲律宾人民自己支付的。

title: Philippine History/The Philippine-American War
en: They were compelled to pay taxes to the U.S. colonial regime to defray a major part of the expenditures and the interest on bonds floated in the name of the Philippine government through the Wall Street banking houses.
zh: 他们被迫向美国殖民政权纳税，用于支付大部分开支，以及通过华尔街银行以菲律宾政府名义发行的债券的利息。

title: Philippine History/The Philippine-American War
en: Of course, the superprofits derived from the protracted exploitation of the Filipino people would constitute the basic gains of U.S. imperialism.
zh: 当然，长期剥削菲律宾人民所获得的高额利润成为美帝国主义的基本收益。

title: Remembering the Templars
en: To understand the Templars one must understand the context that prompted the creation of the order.
zh: 要了解圣殿骑士，就必须了解促使圣殿骑士团成立的背景。

title: Remembering the Templars
en: The age where the events took place is commonly referred as the High Middle Ages the period of European history in the 11th, 12th, and 13th centuries (AD 1000–1300).
zh: 事件发生的时代通常被称为欧洲史的中世纪盛时，即的 11、12 和 13世纪时期（公元 1000-1300 年）。

title: Remembering the Templars
en: The High Middle Ages were preceded by the Early Middle Ages and followed by the Late Middle Ages, which by convention ends around 1500.
zh: 中世纪盛期之前是中世纪早期，之后是中世纪晚期，约定俗成认为中世纪晚期大约在 1500 年前后结束。

title: Costume History/Byzantine
en: In the manner that Paris is known as the fashion capital of the contemporary world, Constantinople was regarded as the fashion capital of feudal Europe.
zh: 正如巴黎被称为当代世界的时尚之都一样，君士坦丁堡被认为是欧洲封建时代的时尚之都。

title: Costume History/Byzantine
en: Its renown for being an epicenter of luxury began in about 400 A.D. and lasted up until about 1100 A.D.
zh: 它作为奢侈品中心的声誉始于公元 400 年左右，一直延续到公元 1100 年左右。

title: Costume History/Byzantine
en: Its status declined during the twelfth century mainly due to the fact that Crusaders had returned bearing gifts such as silks and spices that were valued more than what Byzantine markets offered.
zh: 它的地位在十二世纪下降，主要是因为十字军返回时带的礼物，如丝绸和香料等，比拜占庭市场提供的更有价值。

title: Costume History/Byzantine
en: It was at this time that the transfer of the title of Fashion Capital from Constantinople to Paris was made.
zh: 正是在这个时候，时尚之都的称号从君士坦丁堡转移到了巴黎。

title: Costume History/Gothic
en: Gothic style peaked in the period between the 10th - 11th centuries and the 14th century.
zh: 哥特式风格在 10 - 11 世纪到 14 世纪达到顶峰。

title: Costume History/Gothic
en: At the beginning dress was heavily influenced by the Byzantine culture in the east.
zh: 起初，裙装深受东方拜占庭文化的影响。

title: Costume History/Gothic
en: However, due to the slow communication channels, styles in the west could lag behind by 25 to 30 year.
zh: 然而，由于文化交流迟缓，西方的时尚可能落后 25 到 30 年。

title: Costume History/Gothic
en: towards the end of the Middle Ages western Europe began to develop their own style. one of the biggest developments of the time as a result of the crusades people began to use buttons to fasten clothing.
zh: 随着中世纪走向末期，西欧人民逐渐发展出自己的风格。当时最大的进步之一就是十字军东征后，人们开始用纽扣来系衣服。

title: Introduction to Sociology/Culture
en: Subcultures bring together like-minded individuals who feel neglected by societal standards and allow them to develop a sense of identity.
zh: 亚文化让志同道合的个人团结起来，这些人感到自己被社会标准所忽视，亚文化在他们之间培养出一种认同感。

title: Introduction to Sociology/Culture
en: Subcultures can be distinctive because of the age, ethnicity, class, location, and/or gender of the members.
zh: 鉴于成员的年龄、种族、阶级、位置以及/或性别差异，亚文化可能会各具特色。

title: Introduction to Sociology/Culture
en: The qualities that determine a subculture as distinct may be linguistic, aesthetic, religious, political, sexual, geographical, or a combination of factors.
zh: 让亚文化变得与众不同的特质，可能是语言、美学、宗教、政治、性别、地理或多种因素的组合。

title: Introduction to Sociology/Culture
en: Members of a subculture often signal their membership through a distinctive and symbolic use of style, which includes fashions, mannerisms, and argot.
zh: 亚文化群体的成员，常常会象征性地利用独特的行事风格来表明他们的成员身份，包括时尚服装、举止和黑话。

title: Introduction to Sociology/Socialization
en: One of the most common methods used to illustrate the importance of socialization is to draw upon the few unfortunate cases of children who were, through neglect, misfortune, or wilful abuse, not socialized by adults while they were growing up.
zh: 要说明社会化的重要性，最常用的方法之一是利用少数不幸儿童的案例。这些儿童由于被忽视、遭遇不幸或遭到故意虐待，在成长过程中没有在成年人的帮助下实现社会化。

title: Introduction to Sociology/Socialization
en: Such children are called "feral" or wild. Some feral children have been confined by people (usually their own parents); in some cases this child abandonment was due to the parents' rejection of a child's severe intellectual or physical impairment.
zh: 这样的孩子被称为“野孩”，意思是野孩子。 有些野孩子被人们（通常是他们自己的父母）所幽禁； 在某些情况下，孩子被遗弃是由于父母拒绝接受孩子有智力或身体上的严重缺陷。

title: Introduction to Sociology/Socialization
en: Feral children may have experienced severe child abuse or trauma before being abandoned or running away.
zh: 野孩子在被抛弃或离家出走之前，可能经历过严重的儿童虐待或创伤。

title: Introduction to Sociology/Socialization
en: Others are alleged to have been brought up by animals; some are said to have lived in the wild on their own.
zh: 据说，其他人是被动物养大的；有些人独自生活在野外。

title: Introduction to Sociology/Socialization
en: When completely brought up by non-human animals, the feral child exhibits behaviors (within physical limits) almost entirely like those of the particular care-animal, such as its fear of or indifference to humans.
zh: 狼孩如果完全由非人类的动物抚养长大，其行为（在身体条件允许的范围内）会与该动物非常雷同，比如会对人类表现出恐惧或冷漠。

talk: wikibooks:Social and Cultural Foundations of American Education/Forgotten Half/Perceptions
title: Social and Cultural Foundations of American Education/Forgotten Half/Perceptions
en: Children are placed in Foster Care for a wide variety of reasons that range from neglect, to abuse, and even to extortion.
zh: 孩子们因为各种原因被寄养，原因有被忽视、被虐待，甚至是被勒索。

talk: wikibooks:Social and Cultural Foundations of American Education/Forgotten Half/Perceptions
title: Social and Cultural Foundations of American Education/Forgotten Half/Perceptions
en: No child should ever have to grow up in an environment that is not nurturing, caring, and educational, but they do.
zh: 任何孩子都不应该在一个没有教养、没有关爱、没有教育的环境中成长，但事与愿违。

talk: wikibooks:Social and Cultural Foundations of American Education/Forgotten Half/Perceptions
title: Social and Cultural Foundations of American Education/Forgotten Half/Perceptions
en: We perceive the Foster Care System to be a safety zone for these children.
zh: 我们认为寄养系统对这些孩子来说是一个安全地带。

talk: wikibooks:Social and Cultural Foundations of American Education/Forgotten Half/Perceptions
title: Social and Cultural Foundations of American Education/Forgotten Half/Perceptions
en: Our foster care system is supposed to provide safe homes, loving caregivers, stable education, and reliable health care.
zh: 我们的寄养系统应该提供安全的家、有爱心的看护者、稳定的教育和可靠的医疗。

talk: wikibooks:Social and Cultural Foundations of American Education/Forgotten Half/Perceptions
title: Social and Cultural Foundations of American Education/Forgotten Half/Perceptions
en: Foster care is supposed to provide all the necessities that were lacking in the home they were previously taken from.
zh: 寄养体系应该提供一切其原生家庭所缺乏的必需品。

title: Introduction to Paleoanthropology/Genetics/Introduction
en: Twentieth century research has shown that there are two pools of genetic variation: hidden and expressed.
zh: 二十世纪的研究表明，基因变异有两种库：显性和隐性。

title: Introduction to Paleoanthropology/Genetics/Introduction
en: Mutation adds new genetic variation, and selection removes it from the pool of expressed variation.
zh: 突变会添加新的基因变异，而选择则会从表达的基因变异池中把变异移除。

title: Introduction to Paleoanthropology/Genetics/Introduction
en: Segregation and recombination shuffle variation back and forth between the two pools with each generation.
zh: 由于分离和重组，变异在每一代的两个库之间来回变动。

title: Introduction to Paleoanthropology/Oldowan
en: Out on the savanna, it is hard for a primate with a digestive system like that of humans to satisfy its amino-acid requirements from available plant resources.
zh: 在热带草原上，灵长类动物拥有类似人类的消化系统，现有的植物资源很难满足灵长类动物对氨基酸的需求。

title: Introduction to Paleoanthropology/Oldowan
en: Moreover, failure to do so has serious consequences: growth depression, malnutrition, and ultimately death.
zh: 此外，如果做不到这一点将会带来严重的后果：生长抑制、营养不良，最终导致死亡。

title: Introduction to Paleoanthropology/Oldowan
en: The most readily accessible plant resources would have been the proteins accessible in leaves and legumes, but these are hard for primates like us to digest unless they are cooked.
zh: 最容易获得的植物性资源应该是叶子和豆科植物中的蛋白质，但像我们这样的灵长类动物很难消化这种蛋白质，除非是煮熟的。

title: Introduction to Paleoanthropology/Oldowan
en: In contrast, animal foods (ants, termites, eggs) not only are easily digestible, but they provide high-quantity proteins that contain all the essential amino acids.
zh: 相比之下，动物性食物（蚂蚁、白蚁、蛋）不仅容易消化，而且能提供大量蛋白质，里面含有全部必需的氨基酸。

title: Introduction to Paleoanthropology/Oldowan
en: All things considered, we should not be surprised if our own ancestors solved their "protein problem" in somewhat the same way that chimps on the savanna do today.
zh: 综上所述，如果我们的祖先解决“蛋白质问题”的途径与如今热带草原上的黑猩猩所使用的方法无异，我们也不应该感到惊讶。

title: Lucid Dreaming/Induction Techniques
en: Sleep interruption is the process of purposefully awakening during your normal sleep period and falling asleep a short time later (10–60 minutes).
zh: 睡眠中断是指这样的过程：在正常睡眠期间有意地醒来，并且在短时间之后（10-60分钟）睡着。

title: Lucid Dreaming/Induction Techniques
en: This can be easily done by using a relatively quiet alarm clock to bring you to consciousness without fully waking you.
zh: 这很容易做到，使用相对安静的闹钟，让你在不被完全吵醒的情况下苏醒。

title: Lucid Dreaming/Induction Techniques
en: If you find yourself resetting the clock in your sleep, it can be placed on the other side of the room, forcing you to get out of bed to turn it off.
zh: 如果你发现自己会在睡觉时重置闹钟，可以将闹钟放到房间的另一边，逼迫自己下床去关闹钟。

title: Lucid Dreaming/Induction Techniques
en: Other biorhythm-based options involve drinking lots of fluid (particularly water or tea, a known diuretic) prior to sleep, forcing one to get up to urinate.
zh: 其他基于生物节律的选择包括睡前大量饮用液体（尤其是水或茶——众所周知有利尿作用），强迫自己起来小便。

title: Yoga/What is Yoga
en: The amount of inner peace a person possesses correlates oppositely to the amount of tension in one’s body and spirit.
zh: 一个人内心平静的程度与身体和精神的紧张程度是相反的。

title: Yoga/What is Yoga
en: The lower the tension, the more positive the life force present. Every person has the potential to find absolute peace and contentment.
zh: 压力越小，生命力就表现得越积极。每个人都有可能找到绝对的平静和满足。

title: Yoga/What is Yoga
en: Everyone can achieve enlightenment. The only thing standing in the way of this goal is our own tension and negativity.
zh: 每个人都能达到开悟的境界，而实现它的唯一阻碍是我们自己的紧张感和消极情绪。

title: Yoga/Yoga Tales
en: The Tibetan Buddhism is based on the teachings of Buddha, but were extended by the mahayana path of love and by a lot of techniques from Indian Yoga.
zh: 藏传佛教以佛陀的教义为基础，但通过大乘佛教的普世之爱和印度瑜伽的许多技巧得到了拓展。

title: Yoga/Yoga Tales
en: In principle the Tibetan Buddhism is very simple. It consists of Kundalini Yoga, meditation and the path of all-embracing love.
zh: 原则上，藏传佛教是非常简单的。它包括昆达里尼瑜伽、冥想和普世之爱的方法。

title: Yoga/Yoga Tales
en: With Kundalini Yoga the Kundalini energy (enlightenment energy) is awakened through yoga postures, breathing exercises, mantras and visualizations.
zh: 在昆达里尼瑜伽中，昆达里尼能量（启迪能量）通过瑜伽姿势、呼吸练习、念语和视觉形象被唤醒。

title: Yoga/Yoga Tales
en: The center of Tibetan meditation is the Deity Yoga. Through the visualization of various deities the energy channels are cleaned, the chakras are activated and the enlightenment consciousness is created.
zh: 西藏冥想的核心活动是天瑜伽。通过把不同的神形象化，净化能量通道，激活轮穴，从而达到顿悟的境界。

title: The Cold War/Introduction
en: Germany was a common enemy in World War 2, leading to cooperation between the USSR and USA. With the end of the war the clashes of system, process and culture led to the countries falling out.
zh: 德国是二战中各国的共同敌人，这促进了苏联和美国之间的合作。随着战争的结束，制度、程序和文化上的冲突又使得两国分道扬镳。

title: The Cold War/Introduction
en: With two years of the end of the war, the former allies were now enemies and the Cold War began.
zh: 战争结束两年后，曾经的盟友如今成了敌人，冷战随即开始。

title: The Cold War/Introduction
en: It was to last for the next 40 years and would be fought for real, by proxy armies, on battlefields from Africa to Asia, in Afghanistan, Cuba and many other places.
zh: 这场战争持续了 40 年，代理军队在从非洲到亚洲的很多战场上真刀真枪地战斗，包括在阿富汗和古巴。

title: World War II/Battle of Poland
en: By September 17, 1939, the Polish defense was already broken, and the only hope was to retreat and reorganise along the Romanian bridgehead.
zh: 到了 1939 年 9 月 17 日，波兰的防线已经被攻破，剩下的唯一希望就是沿着罗马尼亚桥头堡撤退和改编军队。

title: World War II/Battle of Poland
en: However, these plans were rendered obsolete nearly overnight, when over 800,000 soldiers from the Soviet's Union Red Army entered and created the Belarussian and Ukrainian fronts after invading the eastern regions of Poland in violation of the Riga Peace Treaty, the Soviet-Polish Non-Aggression Pact, and other international treaties, both bilateral and multilateral.
zh: 然而，这些计划几乎在一夜之间被弃如敝履，在违反《里加和平条约》、《苏联波兰互不侵犯条约》及其他双边及多边国际条约，入侵波兰的东部地区之后，超过 80 万名苏联红军入境，并在白俄罗斯和乌克兰筑起阵地。

title: Warfare
en: Using ships to transport goods is by far the most efficient way to move large amounts of people and goods across oceans.
zh: 迄今为止，船运是跨洋运输大量人员和货物的最有效方式。

title: Warfare
en: The job of navies has traditionally been to ensure that your country maintains the ability to move your people and goods, while at the same time, interfering with your enemy's ability to move his people and goods.
zh: 从传统意义上讲，海军的任务是确保国家保持运输人员和货物的能力，同时，干扰敌人运输其人员和货物的能力。

title: Warfare
en: One of the most noteworthy recent examples of this was the North Atlantic campaign of WWII. The Americans were trying to move men and materials across the Atlantic Ocean to help Britain.
zh: 一个最值得注意的现代的例子就是二战期间的北大西洋战役。美国人尝试横跨大西洋运送人员和物资来帮助英国。

title: Warfare
en: At the same time, the German navy, using mainly U-boats, was trying to stop this traffic.
zh: 与此同时，以 U 型潜艇为主力的德国海军试图拦截这场运输。

title: Warfare
en: Had the Allies failed, Germany probably would have been able to conquer Britain as it had the rest of Europe.
zh: 假如同盟国当时失败了，德国原本很可能像征服欧洲其他国家一样征服英国。

title: Goats/Introduction
en: Goats seem to have been first domesticated roughly 10,000 years ago in the Zagros Mountains of Iran.
zh: 山羊似乎是 1 万年前左右在伊朗的扎格罗斯山脉首次被驯养的。

title: Goats/Introduction
en: Ancient cultures and tribes began to keep them for easy access to milk, hair, meat, and skins.
zh: 古代文明和部落开始驯养它们，食用和使用它们的奶、肉、毛和皮。

title: Goats/Introduction
en: Domestic goats were generally kept in herds that wandered on hills or other grazing areas, often tended by goatherds who were frequently children or adolescents, similar to the more widely known shepherd. These methods of herding are still used today.
zh: 家山羊通常被成群放牧在山上或其他牧区，它们通常由牧山羊人（大多为儿童或青少年）照管，牧山羊人与更广为人知的牧羊人类似。这些放牧方法至今仍在使用。

talk: wikibooks:History of Rail Transport/Early Rail Transportation
title: History of Rail Transport/Early Rail Transportation
en: Wagonways were built in England as early as the 16th Century.
zh: 英国早在 16 世纪就修建了货车道。

talk: wikibooks:History of Rail Transport/Early Rail Transportation
title: History of Rail Transport/Early Rail Transportation
en: Although wagonways merely consisted of parallel planks of wood, they allowed horses pulling them to achieve greater speeds and pull larger loads than on the slightly more rough roads of the day.
zh: 虽然马拉轨道车只是由平行的木板拼成，但在当时，就略显坎坷的道路而言，这些车能让拉车的马跑得更快，拉得更多。

talk: wikibooks:History of Rail Transport/Early Rail Transportation
title: History of Rail Transport/Early Rail Transportation
en: Crossties were introduced fairly early to hold the tracks in place. Gradually, however, it was realised that tracks would be more efficient if they had a stip of iron on the top.
zh: 很早的时候就引进了轨枕，用于固定铁轨。但是，人们逐渐意识到，如果在铁轨上放上铁片，铁轨会更稳固有效。

talk: wikibooks:History of Rail Transport/Early Rail Transportation
title: History of Rail Transport/Early Rail Transportation
en: This became common practice, but the iron caused more wear on the wooden wheels of the wagons.
zh: 这成了普遍做法，但铁片会使木制的马车轮子磨损更严重。

talk: wikibooks:History of Rail Transport/Early Rail Transportation
title: History of Rail Transport/Early Rail Transportation
en: Eventually, wooden wheels were replaced by iron wheels. In 1767, the first full-iron rails were introduced.
zh: 最终，木轮被铁轮所取代。1767 年，第一条全铁轨道问世。

talk: wikibooks:Environmental theory and collection of ideas/Environmentalism and survival
title: Environmental theory and collection of ideas/Environmentalism and survival
en: We can start living more friendly to the environment, we can join to the environmental movement, and we can even be activists in order to reduce the future suffering in some degree.
zh: 我们可以开始更环保地生活，加入环保运动，甚至可以成为环保积极分子，在一定程度上减少将来的灾难。

talk: wikibooks:Environmental theory and collection of ideas/Environmentalism and survival
title: Environmental theory and collection of ideas/Environmentalism and survival
en: This is just like symptomatic treatment in many cases. However, if we do not only want a temporary solution, then we should find the root of the problems, and we should deactivate them.
zh: 很多情况下这和症状疗法很相似。但是，如果我们不仅仅想要一个临时的解决方案的话，那么我们就应该找到问题的根源，并把它彻底根除。

talk: wikibooks:Environmental theory and collection of ideas/Environmentalism and survival
title: Environmental theory and collection of ideas/Environmentalism and survival
en: It is obvious enough that the world has changed much because of humankind's scientific and technological advancements, and problems have become greater because of overpopulation and mankind's extravagant lifestyle.
zh: 显而易见，由于人类的科学和技术进步，世界发生了很大的变化，而人口过剩和人类奢侈的生活方式使问题变得更为严重。

title: American Revolution/The Declaration of Independence
en: After its adoption by Congress on July 4, a handwritten draft signed by the President of Congress John Hancock and the Secretary Charles Thomson was then sent a few blocks away to the printing shop of John Dunlap.
zh: 由议长约翰·汉考克和秘书长查尔斯·汤姆逊签署的手写草案在7月4日得到大陆议会批准，之后被送到几个街区以外的约翰·邓拉普印刷厂付印。

title: American Revolution/The Declaration of Independence
en: Through the night between 150 and 200 copies were made, now known as "Dunlap broadsides".
zh: 一夜之间印刷了 150 到 200 份，就是现在众所周知的“邓拉普宽边”(Dunlap broadsides) 版。

title: American Revolution/The Declaration of Independence
en: The first public reading of the document was by John Nixon in the yard of Independence Hall on July 8.
zh: 7 月 8 日，约翰·尼克松 (John Nixon) 在独立大厅的院子里首次公开宣读了这份文件。

title: American Revolution/The Declaration of Independence
en: One was sent to George Washington on July 6, who had it read to his troops in New York on July 9. A copy reached London on August 10.
zh: 其中一封于 7 月 6 日寄给了乔治·华盛顿，华盛顿于 7 月 9 日在纽约向他的军队宣读了这封信。一份副本于 8 月 10 日抵达伦敦。

title: American Revolution/The Declaration of Independence
en: The 25 Dunlap broadsides still known to exist are the oldest surviving copies of the document. The original handwritten copy has not survived.
zh: 尚存的 25 份当列普单面印刷版（ Dunlap broadsides）是该文件现存最早的版本。手写原稿未能保留下来。

title: Wikijunior:Dinosaurs/Extinction
en: Many paleontologists today believe that one group of dinosaurs survived and is alive today. We call them birds.
zh: 许多古生物学家相信有一群恐龙存活了下来，并一直存活至今，也就是我们所称的“鸟类”。

title: Wikijunior:Dinosaurs/Extinction
en: Many people don't think about them as dinosaurs because they have feathers and can fly.
zh: 很多人认为它们并非恐龙，因为它们有羽毛，会飞。

title: Wikijunior:Dinosaurs/Extinction
en: But there are a lot of things about birds that still look like a dinosaur.
zh: 但鸟类还是有很多地方跟恐龙相似。

title: Wikijunior:Dinosaurs/Extinction
en: They have feet with scales and claws, they lay eggs, and they walk on their two back legs like a T-Rex.
zh: 它们脚上有鳞片和爪子，会产卵，还像霸王龙一样用两条后腿走路。

talk: wikibooks:Parasitic Insects, Mites and Ticks: Genera of Medical and Veterinary Importance/Bloodsucking bugs
title: Parasitic Insects, Mites and Ticks: Genera of Medical and Veterinary Importance/Bloodsucking bugs
en: The term bug is used by entomologists in a formal sense for this group of insects.
zh: 昆虫学家们用“虫子 (bug)”一词来正式称呼这一类的昆虫。

talk: wikibooks:Parasitic Insects, Mites and Ticks: Genera of Medical and Veterinary Importance/Bloodsucking bugs
title: Parasitic Insects, Mites and Ticks: Genera of Medical and Veterinary Importance/Bloodsucking bugs
en: This term derives from ancient familiarity with Bed-bugs, which are insects highly adapted to parasitize humans.
zh: 这个术语源于人们对臭虫的熟悉，臭虫是一种非常适应寄生于人类的昆虫。

talk: wikibooks:Parasitic Insects, Mites and Ticks: Genera of Medical and Veterinary Importance/Bloodsucking bugs
title: Parasitic Insects, Mites and Ticks: Genera of Medical and Veterinary Importance/Bloodsucking bugs
en: Both Assassin-bugs and Bed-bugs are nidicolous, adapted to living in nest or housing of their host.
zh: 猎蝽和臭虫都是留巢昆虫，适应在宿主的巢穴或住房中生活。

talk: wikibooks:Exercise as it relates to Disease/Can Exercise Really Help Multiple Sclerosis?
title: Exercise as it relates to Disease/Can Exercise Really Help Multiple Sclerosis?
en: Across the United States of America, there are approximately 400,000 known cases of Multiple Sclerosis (MS), leaving it as the leading neurological disease in younger and middle aged adults.
zh: 在美国的各个地区，约有 40 万例多发性硬化症 (MS) 病例，这一疾病已经成为中青年的主要神经系统疾病。

talk: wikibooks:Exercise as it relates to Disease/Can Exercise Really Help Multiple Sclerosis?
title: Exercise as it relates to Disease/Can Exercise Really Help Multiple Sclerosis?
en: MS is a disease that affects the central nervous system, which is made up of the brain, the spinal cord and the optic nerve.
zh: 多发性硬化是一种影响中枢神经系统（由脑、脊髓和视神经组成）的疾病。

talk: wikibooks:Exercise as it relates to Disease/Can Exercise Really Help Multiple Sclerosis?
title: Exercise as it relates to Disease/Can Exercise Really Help Multiple Sclerosis?
en: Research has found that females are two times more likely to have MS then males.
zh: 研究发现，女性患多发性硬化症 (MS) 的几率是男性的两倍。

title: Sexual Health/Pregnancy
en: A couple may decide it is not in their best interest, or in the interest of their child, to raise a baby.
zh: 一对夫妻可能出于自己的利益，或者为其子女利益着想，因而决定不进行生育。

title: Sexual Health/Pregnancy
en: These couples may choose to make an adoption plan for their baby.
zh: 这些夫妇可能会为他们的孩子制定收养计划。

title: Sexual Health/Pregnancy
en: In an adoption, the birth parents terminate their parental rights so that another couple may parent the child.
